headline.text: L3 ML4 metal detector ML1 rejecting *all* test cards since overnight — root cause unknown, TG3 down most of shift.

summary: One active hold on L2 ML3 for quality defects. Plastic found in L1 S4 mixing tank filter before product contact — no product exposed. L3 ML4 ran 2,000+ lbs scrap overnight due to dirty-mold jams and metal-detector faults; line stopped at shift end for deep troubleshooting.

holds.title: Last pallet held for doubles, empties, open pieces
holds.summary: Final box inspection on ML3 peppermint cream run found open, empty, and double pieces; last pallet placed on hold pending maintenance adjustments, operator stationed at Z conveyor to hand-sort remainder of shift.
holds.status: On hold pending disposition; manual sorting in place for continued production.

food_safety.title: Plastic in S4 mixing tank filter
food_safety.summary: White plastic from brown sugar bag found in filter at 05:32 during batch prep; no product in tank, tank cleaned prior to finding, fully rinsed after — no additional pieces found.
food_safety.status: Resolved — tank rinsed, first batch dropped at 07:01 after full verification.

food_safety.title: ML4 metal detector TG3/ML1 rejecting all test cards
food_safety.summary: Metal detector at ML1 faulting continuously since overnight, rejecting all test cards; TG3 down most of third shift and into first; root cause unknown, WDS support engaged.
food_safety.status: Open — maintenance and WDS troubleshooting, line stopped at 05:10 after 2,000 lbs scrap.

food_safety.title: ML4 licking roller 2 missing parts at startup
food_safety.summary: Third shift found licking roller 2 disassembled with pieces missing; led to repeated mold jams from chocolate buildup; parts reinstalled, mold jams stopped.
food_safety.status: Resolved after parts reinstalled at 03:23; depositing resumed.

food_safety.title: S4 top cover crack with coating detachment
food_safety.summary: Longitudinal crack identified in S4 top cover #2 with surface coating lifting in areas; potential for coating fragments to enter product zone.
food_safety.status: Open — inspection and evaluation by maintenance recommended, not yet addressed.

quality.title: S3 sealer gate setting off, unsealed jars passed
quality.summary: Sealer error allowed jars to pass while sealer was off; HMI setting 'Stop gates on error' had been turned off (password-protected screen); setting restored.
quality.status: Resolved — setting re-enabled, unknown who disabled it.

quality.title: ML2 flow wrap open seals
quality.summary: Film seals opening despite cleaning, fill adjustments, and film roll change; maintenance worked issue for 3+ hours across second shift.
quality.status: Resolved — line running with good seals and water-leak-test pass by 19:10.

quality.title: S3 decorator chocolate appearance dark after cooling
quality.summary: Decorator drizzle too dark after cooling tunnel; transferred half of decorator tank to enrober tank and added fresh chocolate, still pronounced; QA approved restart after buffer tank refresh.
quality.status: Resolved — line restarted at 18:31 after QA approval.

quality.title: ML3 recurring doubles and triples
quality.summary: Mid-shift count found 750 pieces (target 744) with 15 doubles; issue resolved, then recurred at 13:09; sensor and forming-plate adjustments made.
quality.status: Resolved by 12:41 after sensor/vacuum work; no further doubles found after 19:38 count.

quality.title: FFS checkweigher false overweight rejections
quality.summary: High rate of overweight blow-offs on pouches; manual verification shows only 1 in 5 truly overweight, rest within spec.
quality.status: Open — maintenance to investigate checkweigher calibration.

quality.title: ML4 depositor pump systems cross-connected
quality.summary: Depositor 2 pump on depositor 3, depositor 3 pump on depositor 2; operators filled hoppers before discovery; both hoppers washed and swapped back.
quality.status: Resolved after hoppers washed and reinstalled; depositing resumed at 13:04.

sanitation.title: S3 drain epoxy chipping off
sanitation.summary: Epoxy coating on S3 drain starting to chip; potential foreign material risk if pieces detach into drainage system.

sanitation.title: S4 salt residue after level 2 cleaning
sanitation.summary: Food-contact surfaces passed ATP, but salt particles remain on cable covers below belts, THG, and fixed-cover crevices; touch-up needed before caramel return.
sanitation.status: Open — touch-up cleaning scheduled before next caramel run.

sanitation.title: ML4 dirty molds caused overnight mold jams
sanitation.summary: Molds sticking together in cooling cabinet 1 exit due to buildup; 12+ jams from 06:00–13:00, over 2,000 lbs scrap; licking roller found off at start of third shift.
sanitation.status: Line stopped at 05:10 to run empty and swap in clean molds; restart planned after inspection.

sanitation.title: Ladder with chocolate and caramel buildup
sanitation.summary: Ladder next to S2 tunnel 3 has chocolate and caramel on wheels and steps; not labeled per MSS, unclear which ladder designation.
sanitation.status: Open — needs cleaning and labeling per MSS.

sanitation.title: S2 cross conveyor not cleaned
sanitation.summary: Cross conveyor near S2 pack appears uncleaned after changeover.

opportunities.title: S3 sealer gate setting off, unsealed jars passed
opportunities.text: Consider restricting HMI password access or adding a daily startup verification that 'Stop gates on error' is enabled — based on sealer gate setting found disabled with unknown cause, allowing unsealed jars to pass.

opportunities.title: ML4 depositor pump systems cross-connected
opportunities.text: Consider adding color-coded tags or startup photo verification for depositor pump-system connections — based on pumps found swapped between depositors 2 and 3, requiring hopper wash-out.

opportunities.title: ML4 licking roller 2 missing parts at startup
opportunities.text: Consider adding licking-roller assembly check to ML4 startup checklist — based on roller found disassembled at third-shift start, causing 12+ mold jams and 2,000 lbs scrap before discovery.
